def _write(self, d, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(d, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_include_override_order(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self._write(d, "inc.conf", "a = 1\nb = 2\n")
            main = self._write(d, "main.conf", "a = 0\n@include inc.conf\nb = 3\n")
            cfg = load(main)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), 1)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), 3)

    def test_include_relative_to_including_file_and_nested(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self._write(d, "sub/leaf.conf", "x = 5\n")
            self._write(d, "sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\ny = 6\n")
            main = self._write(d, "main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\n")
            cfg = load(main)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("x"), 5)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("y"), 6)

    def test_include_missing(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            main = self._write(d, "main.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(main)

    def test_include_cycles(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self._write(d, "self.conf", "@include self.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(os.path.join(d, "self.conf"))
            self._write(d, "a.conf", "@include b.conf\n")
            self._write(d, "b.conf", "@include a.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(os.path.join(d, "a.conf"))

    def test_repeated_include_is_not_a_cycle(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self._write(d, "c.conf", "k = 1\n")
            main = self._write(d, "main.conf", "@include c.conf\n@include c.conf\n")
            self.assertEqual(load(main).get("k"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
